why: No major reviewer or authority tests solar generator kits under $500. The famous names are all deal posts (TechRadar x2, Good Housekeeping, Popular Mechanics, Car and Driver), news (The Verge) or off-target gear guides (SFGate, Strategist). Only three niche sites touch the kit question with specs or price tracking (powersized, OffGridEmpire, RoverSolar), none with checkable testing and only OffGridEmpire at the exact price band; the rest are affiliate station-only roundups that ignore the panel. This mirrors the under-$1,000 win.
